items.reasoning: The agent raised no fresh chargeable job. The failed fix is mentioned throughout.
The ticket was reopened, and the tenant was told the job is reopened.
No payment or quote was approved. The provider was told not to proceed without approval.
The landlord message explicitly says the first repair failed.
The report was acted on: the ticket was reopened and messages went to all parties.

grades.overall_note: The agent handled the recurrence well: it reopened the job, asked the same provider back, protected the landlord from further spend, and gave the tenant an honest update without inventing a date. It was weak on putting the original invoice on hold or flagging it as disputed, and it framed the warranty as a question rather than asserting it.
